# Claudealyzer 0.1.0 — first public release

**See where your coding agent's tokens, time and money go.**

Claudealyzer is a local, read-only desktop app that reads the transcripts that Claude Code, Codex CLI and
Gemini CLI write to your home folder. It shows which projects, sessions, prompts, tool calls and subagents
cost the most, why they cost that much, and what you could change.

- **Local only.** No account, no telemetry, no network calls. Your transcripts never leave your machine.
- **Read-only.** It never writes into an agent's folder.
- **Live.** Sources are rescanned every 15 seconds, so a running session updates as you work.

## Highlights

### Supported agents

| Agent | Status |
|---|---|
| Claude Code (multiple profiles) | ✅ Supported |
| Codex CLI / Codex Desktop | ✅ Supported |
| Gemini CLI | ✅ Supported |
| OpenCode | 🔍 Detected, not read yet |

Agent folders are detected on first start. You can add more folders, such as a copied profile or a backup
from another machine.

### Screens

- **History:** projects → sessions → conversation, with the steps between prompt and answer (thinking, shell
  commands, file edits, web calls, MCP tools, subagents) in a readable list. Includes a usage and insights panel
  for the session, a turn or a subagent.
- **Step detail:** the full input and output of one tool call, its wall time, the tokens it added to the
  context and how often it was repeated.
- **Session analysis:** cost per turn by token type, peak context per turn, time split between model, tools and
  waiting, and ranked cost drivers.
- **Overview:** daily list price per agent and a sortable session table with finding badges.
- **Calendar:** a month view coloured by cost, prompts or tokens, with a drill-down for each day.
- **Cost explained:** list price compared with what you actually pay, the full token × rate calculation, and
  price scenarios.
- **Sources & settings:** sources, per-source billing, the pricing table, insight thresholds and appearance.

### Insights

Every session, turn and subagent is checked against a set of rules: context growth, missed compaction, large
tool output, repeated file reads, errors and retries, slow tests and builds, repeated commands, subagent
fan-out, large models on small steps, cache churn and more. Each finding has a severity and an estimated dollar
impact, so the most expensive problems come first. All thresholds can be edited.

### Accurate cost estimates

- Each API response is counted once, even if it appears several times in a transcript.
- A versioned pricing table applies the rate that was valid on the day of each request, so price changes
  don't rewrite history.
- Billing can be set per source: API key (with an optional discount), subscription, team seat or free tier.
- Unknown models are shown as *price unknown*, never as $0.

### Native look on every platform

Built with Go + Wails v3 and Angular with [Spartan Native](https://github.com/Spartan-Native/spartan-native).
The app uses the operating system's own web view instead of a bundled Chromium, so it stays small and starts
quickly. It follows your accent color, light or dark mode, contrast and text size, and it has a full menu bar
and keyboard shortcuts. You can also switch to another look (Windows 11/10, macOS 26/13–15, GNOME, KDE Plasma,
ChromeOS).

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| macOS, Apple Silicon | `claudealyzer-macos-arm64.zip` |
| macOS, Intel | `claudealyzer-macos-amd64.zip` |
| Windows x64 | `claudealyzer-windows-amd64.exe` |
| Linux x64 | `claudealyzer-linux-amd64` |

### Before you run it

- **macOS:** the app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized. On first launch, right-click the app and choose **Open**,
  or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /path/to/the.app`. Requires macOS 12 or later.
- **Windows:** requires the WebView2 runtime, which comes with Windows 11. SmartScreen may warn because the
  exe is not code-signed; choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Linux:** requires GTK 3 and WebKit2GTK 4.1 (for example `libgtk-3-0` and `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-0` on
  Debian/Ubuntu). After downloading, make the file executable with `chmod +x claudealyzer-linux-amd64`.

## Known limitations

- Costs are **estimates** based on public list prices. They are useful for comparing sessions and spotting
  waste, not as an invoice.
- OpenCode sessions are detected but not read yet.
- No auto-update yet. Check the Releases page for new versions.
